'''Cellheim Anujo''' was an individual who served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]], one of two Senators for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Anujo and Dowmeia were part of a group of dignitaries who greeted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] after his rescue from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prison/Legends|captivity]] in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Cellheim Anujo served as [[Aide/Legends|aide]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|36|Anujo, Cellheim}}</ref> to the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]], a [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]]<ref name="Dowmeia DB">{{DB|character|tundradowmeia|Dowmeia, Tundra}}</ref> senator in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]'s [[Delegation of 2,000]]. Dowmeia stood as one of the two joint representatives<ref name="CSWE Dowmeia">{{CSWECite|I|203|Dowmeia, Tundra}}</ref> for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], alongside<ref name="CSWE Dowmeia" /> the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]<ref name="DB Tills">{{DB|character|meenatills|Tills, Meena}}</ref> [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]].<ref name="CSWE Dowmeia" /> Anujo served Dowmeia during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="DB" /> a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Clone Wars">{{CSWECite|I|131|Clone Wars}}</ref> which lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[File:SenateGreetingParty.png|250px|left|thumb|Cellheim Anujo (center) was one of the dignitaries welcoming Palpatine back to Coruscant's surface after the Battle of Coruscant.]]

In 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> following the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Anujo and Dowmeia were part of a group of dignitaries gathered at the landing platform of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Senate Office Building]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to greet [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Palpatine had been rescued from his [[Prison/Legends|captivity]] on the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] by two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. As Palpatine disembarked from a [[Jedi shuttlebus/Legends|Jedi shuttlebus]] with Skywalker, Anujo stood next to Senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. The group then moved forward to greet Palpatine and his saviors, before walking behind the [[Chancellor/Legends|chancellor]] into the Senate Building.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Personality and traits==
Anujo was considered mysterious.<ref name="DB" />

==Equipment==
Anujo's Senate outfit,<ref name="DaG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> which they wore on the landing platform,<ref name="ROTS" /> consisted of body-covering<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]], a black [[Clothing/Legends|veil]], and black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]].<ref name="DaG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Strongest memory has to be after we did the first take George Lucas was talking to his First Assistant Director about the set-up, he then left and George came over to me. He told me what we were going to do for the next set up and that the shot would be starting on me! That's quite a feeling when you've grown up playing with the little action figures then you've got the Director of this telling you they're going to start the shot on you!|Dean Mitchell|<ref name="Interview">{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/prequel-trilogy/episode-iii-revenge-of-the-sith/dean-mitchell-cellheim-anujo|text=Dean Mitchel (Cellheim Anujo)|author=[[Dennis Pellegrom]]|date=2010-05|work=[[Star Wars Interviews]]|archivedate=20221209055817|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:AnujoUnmasked-Featurette.png|250px|right|thumb|Cellheim Anujo was portrayed by T.V. Moore and Dean Mitchell for the landing platform scene.]]
Cellheim Anujo appeared in the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The character was portrayed by [[T.V. Moore]]<ref name="Snapshot">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/explore/sithsnap/2005/10/sithsnap20051010.html|text=''Sith'' Snapshots: Sith Snapshots: Loyal Delegates}}</ref> during filming in [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]],<ref name="Mitchell website">{{WebCite|url=http://www.deanmitchell.net/html/star_wars.html|text=deanmitchell.net|archivedate=20080723222127|nolive=1}}</ref> where the landing platform scene was filmed on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 22]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> [[Dean Mitchell]] then portrayed the character in scenes later shot at [[Shepperton Studios]] in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]]. For the second take, director [[George Lucas]] informed Mitchell that the shot would be starting focused on Anujo, but that take was not used in the final version of the film. The sheer weight of the fabrics in the Anujo costume caused Mitchell to get very hot while filming, but due to the size of Anujo's cloth headpiece, Mitchell was able to take it off between takes to cool down.<ref name="Interview" />

The character was first alluded to in an entry in the [[Episode III Set Diary]] on [[StarWars.com]] posted by the site's Internet Content Manager [[Pablo Hidalgo]] on July 22, 2003.<ref name="Diary">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20030722.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=Two Dozen's A Crowd}}</ref> Unnamed in the movie itself,<ref name="ROTS" /> Anujo was identified by the release of ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="DaG" /> and released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DaG release">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref>
